messages:
Maya: Quick sync on catalog -> compare UX. Noticed filters and search disappear when you switch. Feels jarring. Do we want to persist everything or only a minimal set? Theo: Persist minimally: query, selected filter ids, and pinned model ids. Other UI bits (expanded rows, sort) can be session-only. Keeps deep links small. Priya: Agree. For copy, prefer 'Pinned to compare' vs 'Pinned (compare)'. Use the former for clarity. Ken: Accessibility concerns: when compare view loads we must notify ATs and move focus sensibly. Suggested pattern: set focus to the compare heading and put an aria-live summary. Ruth: +1. Also when pining/unpinning, emit a non-intrusive status message. Example: 'Model Atlas v3 pinned to compare'. Don't rely on tooltip only. Maya: UX detail: should pinning from list update the compare preview inline (right rail) so users see immediate feedback without navigating? I think yes. Theo: Implementation plan: (1) store URL-friendly state: q, f (filter ids), pins (model ids) in /compare querystring, encoded. (2) if querystring length > 1800 chars, fallback to sessionStorage with short token in URL. (3) use websocket / small PATCH endpoint to sync pin state across tabs. Priya: Motion & animation: nice-to-have is a subtle transition that conveys continuity (row moves to compare). Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ken: Keyboard flow: if user had a row focused, keep selection/focus on that model in compare. If not present, focus first interactive control. Also ensure skip links still work. Ruth: microcopy suggestion for empty compare: 'No models pinned yet. Pin a version to compare performance and quality.' Short and action-oriented. Maya: QA checklist draft: preserve query in URL, preserve filter chips, pins persist across view switches, inline compare preview updates on pin, screen reader announcements for load & pin, focus landing rules, reduced-motion variant. Theo: I'll spike the URL encoding + session fallback today and post PR with unit tests for serialization. Priya: I'll update Figma with pinned label treatment and add hover and focus states. Link: https://figma.com/file/abc/compare-inline-preview (preview) Ken: aria snippet to include in PR notes: ```
Compare view loaded: 3 models, filters preserved.
Model Atlas v3 pinned to compare.
``` Ruth: Also add unit tests for keyboard focus after navigation. Non-visual regressions are easy to miss. Maya: Anything blocking? Theo: Need API review for pin sync, otherwise good. ui-bot: deploy-preview: compare-inline-preserve available at https://staging.redwood.dev/compare-inline-preview snapshot Maya: thanks everyone. I'll create tasks and label under UX -> Catalog Compare. Assigning reviewers: @Priya for visuals, @Ken for accessibility, @Theo for engineering.
